summary: reportStatus.assess in internal/report compared the computed efficacy and coverage percentages to their configured thresholds with <=, so a result exactly at the configured minimum failed the quality gate instead of passing it. The fix changes both comparisons to <, so only a result strictly below its threshold fails. No package dependency, CLI flag, configuration key, report field, or exit code changes.
trust_boundaries: reportStatus.assess remains local computation over already-collected mutant results. It calls no new function, reads no new input, and does not change what is logged or reported. No network call, external process, or generated code is involved.
